# What the claims do not read, the comparison cannot weigh

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-the-claims-do-not-read` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](what-the-claims-do-not-read.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Under BasicPriority two alternatives realizing the same claims are compared alike, neither better than the other, so a loss laid on someone by another's part and the same loss self-borne are not ordered; adjoined as a basic claim, the agent orders them.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Inclusion and strict inclusion carry over to claims held alike, and so does Above on either side. (`Becoming.Lexical.Included.congr`, `Becoming.Lexical.StrictIncluded.congr`, `Becoming.Lexical.Above.congr_left`, `Becoming.Lexical.Above.congr_right`)
2. Under BasicPriority, alternatives realizing the same basic claims and gains: neither better, and each better or worse than a third exactly where the other is. (`Becoming.Lexical.BasicPriority.same_claims_alike`)
3. A fresh basic claim held by the self-borne alternative and not the imposed one puts the self-borne above, where it holds the imposed one's old basic claims. (`Becoming.Lexical.Above.agent_adjoined`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; BasicPriority is a hypothesis wherever better is concluded.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which of imposed and self-borne loss is worse, or that the agent belongs among the basic claims.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
